mods.name: Ender Canteen
mods.description:
Ender Canteen adds a canteen item that can be linked to any fluid tank.
If the linked tank contains water, you can drink directly from it using the canteen.
Optionally integrates with "Thirst Was Taken" to restore thirst points.
A Fluid Tap block is also included to bridge between the canteen and tanks that
do not directly expose a fluid handler capability.
